<thought>The spectrum shows a clear M+2 peak at ~4.6 % of the base peak, matching the natural abundance of ^34S (≈4.2 %). No 3:1 or 1:1 M+2 patterns characteristic of Cl or Br are present, and the M+1 intensity is consistent with many carbons but does not uniquely identify an element. Thus, sulfur is the only element that can be definitively identified from the isotopic pattern.</thought>
<final_answer>['S']</final_answer>
